description: This file defines a custom JSP tag class 'StoreBreadcrumbsTag' used for rendering breadcrumb navigation links based on the shopping store's category hierarchy and request attributes.

classes.name: StoreBreadcrumbsTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag support class for generating breadcrumb references for a store, with methods for processing the breadcrumb data and rendering the URL reference.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Main method that executes when the tag is encountered; constructs and prints the breadcrumb URL reference based on request attributes and class parameters.

methods.name: parseBreadCrumb
methods.description: Helper method that parses breadcrumb URL reference content into a list of category ID strings.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Method called at the end of tag processing; returns SKIP_PAGE behavior.
